{{- /* Resolves the URL of a theme static asset (css/js/fonts/images). With .Site.Params.assetsBase set (a URL prefix ending in "/"), assets are loaded from that shared location instead of this documentation version's own copy, so every published version serves the same files. The prefix is contract-versioned (e.g. .../assets/v1/): bump it whenever the JS/CSS and the theme layouts change incompatibly, and only builds carrying the matching layouts point at the new prefix. No cache-busting query is added in this mode — the prefix changes when the content does. With assetsBase unset (local hugo serve, standalone builds), assets resolve inside this version as before, with cache busting unless disableAssetsBusting is set. Pass "busting" false to skip the query string (e.g. the favicon, which never carried it). Usage: {{ partial "asset-url.html" (dict "site" .Site "path" "css/theme-base.css") }} */ -}} {{- $busting := ne .busting false -}} {{- with .site.Params.assetsBase -}} {{- printf "%s%s" . $.path -}} {{- else -}} {{- .path | relURL -}}{{- if and $busting (not .site.Params.disableAssetsBusting) -}}?{{ now.Unix }}{{- end -}} {{- end -}}
